primitives.name: Cron Authentication Consistency
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every one of the 25 calls `cronAuthError(request)` (or `authorizeCronRequest`) as the FIRST statement of the GET/POST handler, before any `await db.*`.
primitives.assumptions: All cron handlers execute sequentially and auth precedes DB access.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if auth check is bypassed or reordered.

primitives.name: Idempotent Event Handling
